evidence.quoted_text: self.assertFalse(any('start' in argv or 'enable' in argv for argv in calls))
evidence.reason: The negative assertion only checks whether an argv element is exactly 'start' or 'enable'. A recorded command such as ['systemctl','--user','restart','crq-tick.service'] contains neither exact element, so the test still passes even though restart can start an inactive unit. The test also never asserts that daemon-reload is the only mutating systemctl call, leaving its stated inert-prepare guarantee unverified. This is a minor test-correctness gap, not a new product requirement.
